## ADVENTURE SETTING
Create an original fantasy world inspired by popular isekai anime. A world of magic, mythical creatures, dungeons, guilds, reminiscent of anime isekai stories.
Anime and manga become reality in this new world. Characters have big eyes, tiny noses, and small lips **exactly like anime characters do**.
The protagonist arrives in another world through any typical isekai mechanism
(e.g., reincarnation, teleportation, summoning, curse, artifact activation, VR entrapment, etc.).

## EXAMPLE ANIME (INSPIRATION ONLY)
Use the following titles only as thematic references, NOT as templates to copy:
- Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken (That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime)
- The Rising of the Shield Hero
- The Eminence in Shadow
- Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
- Tsukimichi: Moonlit Fantasy

## ISEKAI TROPES & ELEMENTS (REQUIRED)
The world you generate must include:
- **Multiple kingdoms or factions** with distinct cultures, politics, conflicts, and agendas.
- **Magic systems, classes, skills, and abilities**.
- **A variety of races**, both common (humans, elves, dwarves, beastfolk, demons, spirits)
  and newly invented races unique to this world.
- **Adventurer guilds** with quest boards, ranks, and structured guild systems.
- **Dungeons, ruins, labyrinths, ancient structures**, and **magical zones** that may bend or break normal rules.
- **Mythical creatures**, both classic and original.
- A **technology level** typical of fantasy worlds (medieval → early industrial).
- **Gods, Demon Lords, Vampires**, and other beings who transcend mortal limits.
  These higher beings are aware of "otherworlders" as anomalies—subjects to test, manipulate, or eliminate.
- Romance tropes as natural possibilities: harems, love triangles, polygamy — but only when **earned through interaction**, never forced or instant.
- All fantasy-staples: magic, artifacts, **sentient weapons**, weapons who possess their wielders, etc.
## PERSONALITY ARCHETYPES
The following archetypes should **exist in the world** and appear naturally over time. They are behavioral templates—mix, subvert, or combine freely with any character role or appearance:
- **Tsundere**: Proud, flustered, secretly caring.
- **Dandere**: Quiet, reserved, opens up slowly.
- **Kuudere**: Cool, composed, emotionally understated.
- **Yandere**: Obsessive, possessive, unstable devotion.
- **Deredere**: Openly affectionate, warm, cheerful.
- **Genki**: Energetic, optimistic, relentlessly upbeat.
- **Ojou-sama**: Refined, aristocratic, may be sheltered or haughty.
- **Femme Fatale**: Ambitious, alluring, morally ambiguous.

## CHARACTER GUIDELINES
- **Pacing**: Introduce characters organically through the world — quests, encounters, factions — not as a parade of romantic interests.
- **Depth over tropes**: Each character should have goals, flaws, and agency beyond their archetype.
- **Earning bonds**: Romance, loyalty, and affection develop through meaningful interaction, not proximity or protagonist privilege.
- **Balance**: The world has many characters. Not every woman is a potential harem member. Include male allies, rivals, mentors, and antagonists naturally.

## ADVENTURER'S GUILD - RANK SYSTEM
Iron — Entry level. New adventurers, unproven. Limited to non-combat work, simple errands, manual labor, low-risk tasks. Probationary period applies.
Bronze — Proven basics. Can handle minor threats: small beast packs, bandits (1-3), simple escorts, low-danger dungeon floors. Still expected to work in groups for anything serious.
Silver — Professional. Competent solo operators or reliable team members. Mid-tier monsters, organized bandit groups (4-8), moderate dungeon depths, escort through dangerous territory.
Gold — Elite. Trusted with high-stakes contracts. Powerful monsters, large-scale threats, politically sensitive missions, deep dungeon expeditions.
Platinum — Legendary. Kingdom-level threats, demon incursions, dragon hunts, missions that shape history. Rare. Most guilds have only a handful.
</adventure-setting>
